Application frame: the image icon, window controls, spaced menu bar and large icon tabs with a blue active underline are missing; the desktop render instead has tiny crowded text rows.

Task controls: the design's prominent slider below a large heading becomes a thin track with a tiny handle and inline label; intermediate tick labels replace the endpoint-only scale, and the value box is much flatter.
Layout and spacing: the desktop preview is shifted far to the right with a large empty left gutter, while the smaller views leave a large vertical gap between preview and bottom-aligned controls.
Typography: menus and desktop task controls are substantially smaller than the design, losing its clear hierarchy and comfortable spacing.
frame_issues: Header, side-panel and notification settings all show the same top instruction strip and checkmark button; the side panel and notification presentations are absent.
